home.title: Garages near your event
home.intro: Soon you will be able to book a spot by the hour in Guadalajara.

spaces.covered: Covered spot for a compact car

styleguide.title: ParkApp design system
styleguide.intro: Tokens, components and patterns. Every text color meets WCAG AA and every touch target is at least 44 px.

colors.title: Color
colors.intro: Deep blue for brand and navigation. Amber only for the main action. Everything else is neutral.

usage.brand: signal-700 is the brand blue: navigation, links, the ticket panel. Light tones are soft backgrounds.
usage.action: ticket-400 is the action color (reserve, pay, publish). It is a fill: never text or an outline on a light background.
usage.neutral: ink for text, ink-muted for support text, control for field and button borders, line for dividers only.
usage.semantic: Success, error and warning. Always paired with text.

contrast.title: Verified contrast
contrast.intro: These are the combinations the components use. An automated test fails if any of them stops passing.

type.title: Typography
type.intro: Bricolage Grotesque for headlines and prices; Figtree for interface and text. Figures use tabular numbers.

samples.headline: Garages near your event
samples.title: Garage with electric gate
samples.lead: Book in four steps and drive straight to your spot.
samples.body: Your spot is held for up to 15 minutes after your arrival time.
samples.caption: Free cancellation until 10 minutes before

buttons.title: Controls
buttons.intro: One main action per screen: the thing the person came to do.

forms.title: Fields and selection
forms.plateError: Enter the full plate, for example ABC-123.
forms.alerts: Remind me 15 minutes before it ends

feedback.title: Status and loading
feedback.emptyBody: Try a wider radius or change your arrival time.

cards.title: Cards and ticket
cards.intro: The photo comes first; price and reviews are always visible. A confirmed booking is an event ticket.
cards.ticketIntro: Shown on confirmation and in My bookings. The bottom half is the stub you show at the entrance.

nav.title: Navigation
nav.intro: Booking takes four steps at most. Listing a garage is also four, in order.

patterns.title: Map and list
patterns.intro: On a phone the map fills the screen and the list lives in a panel with three heights. On desktop the list sits beside the map. Hovering a card highlights its price on the map.
